founder_intent.deeper_control_layer: Authenticated proof and lifecycle truth must precede consequence; transport arrival may not manufacture authority and emission alone may not count as delivery.

transport_reordering_procedure: Create the sender-owned probe with the exact edge, SearchKey, allocation, source, and destination.
Capture the real __search__ tuple and Terminal from the sender Unit outbox.
Deliver the Terminal first through Unit.step with the actual immediate sender.
Deliver the original search tuple second through Unit.step without replaying the Terminal.
Require one hold, one application, no orphan counter, no duplicate application, and no proposal or child expansion before the held command closes the new node.
non_vacuity_controls: A forged sender using the same full Terminal is rejected while the paired legitimate sender is held.
Sender-side emission without receiver-side delivery does not apply on another edge.
A same-kind Terminal with a different reason is a full-identity conflict, not an exact replay.
Twenty-five authenticated conflicts move the conflict counter twenty-five times while retained conflict state remains one fingerprint.
A context-mismatched search creates no node and consumes no held control; the later valid search adopts and applies it.

pass_1.finding: The existing accepted_control is written at sender emission, so it cannot by itself prove receiver arrival.
pass_1.strengthening: Keep the full Terminal in the canonical lifecycle but add a scalar arrival state; only authenticated receiver delivery may move it to held.
disadvantages_preserved: A held edge can remain unresolved if its search never arrives.
A special pending dictionary would be simpler to query but would duplicate lifecycle truth.

pass_2.finding: The arrival marker could still permit conflict growth, replay ambiguity, cross-edge application, or consumption by a failed context adoption.
pass_2.strengthening: Use full canonical Terminal identity, a one-fingerprint conflict bound, explicit replay counters, edge-local lookup only, commit-time revalidation, and delayed consumption until a valid context-bound node exists.
residual_risks: No time-based garbage collection is added; bounded unresolved lifecycle state remains until a later separately preregistered retention policy.
The in-memory scheduler normally preserves search-before-control order; the proof boundary is adversarial transport reordering, not a scheduler rewrite.

pass_criteria: All 15 frozen specifications pass without marker edits in the runtime commit.
The related provenance, direction, sealing, admission, completion, and projection suites do not regress.
No duplicate processing, forged acceptance, credit mutation before adoption, replay ambiguity, lifecycle divergence, second pending registry, or unbounded conflict retention occurs.
The marker-only activation commit removes exactly the 15 declared marker lines and changes no assertion or fixture.
The adversarial twin produces lifecycle, credit, message, and counter parity between normal and reversed transport after reconciliation.
kill_criteria: Any design requires retaining unauthenticated input.
Any design requires a second pending queue or dictionary.
Any implementation applies a control on emission without receiver delivery.
Any implementation weakens SearchContext validation, sender-owned ingress, or command/outcome separation.
Any full-suite regression, unexpected XPASS before runtime, altered frozen assertion, duplicate application, or credit divergence stops the work.
explicitly_out_of_scope: wallet, treasury, self-preservation, or self-modification capabilities
